summary: A user was contacted by someone impersonating Binance security who instructed them to import a provided twelve word seed phrase into a SafePal wallet to transfer funds for review. The user entered the phrase into the app but did not complete the submission and later sought advice about potential exposure.
user_mistake: engaged with impersonator and entered provided seed phrase into wallet app
prevention: Ignore unsolicited security calls and contact exchange using official website number / Never import seed phrase provided by caller into wallet
